variables.name: component/message/background/primary
variables.comment: Primary mode base background. Applied to non-error variants on primary surface. Lite: --message-mode-primary-background → color/background/layer-01.

variables.name: component/message/background/secondary
variables.comment: Secondary mode base background. Applied to non-error variants on secondary surface. Lite: --message-mode-secondary-background → color/background/layer-02.

variables.name: component/message/background/information-default
variables.comment: Information variant background override. Today aliases to primary base. Future brands may use a distinct info background (e.g. light blue).

variables.name: component/message/background/success-default
variables.comment: Success variant background override. Today aliases to primary base. Future brands may use a distinct success background (e.g. light green).

variables.name: component/message/background/warning-default
variables.comment: Warning variant background override. Today aliases to primary base. Future brands may use a distinct warning background (e.g. light yellow).

variables.name: component/message/background/error-default
variables.comment: Error variant background override. Uses danger/discrete — distinct from base in all modes. Lite: --message-error-background → color/system/danger/discrete.

variables.name: component/message/text/information-default
variables.comment: Information variant text. All → color/text/strong today. Per-variant for future brand flexibility.

variables.name: component/message/text/success-default
variables.comment: Success variant text. Same as information today.

variables.name: component/message/text/warning-default
variables.comment: Warning variant text. Same as information today.

variables.name: component/message/text/error-default
variables.comment: Error variant text. Same as information today. Future brands may use variant-specific text.

variables.name: component/message/text/error-highlight-default
variables.comment: Error highlight text for minimal variant header. Communicates error through text when border/icon are absent. Lite: --message-error-header-text-color → color/system/danger/default.

variables.name: component/message/border/information-default
variables.comment: Information variant 4px left stripe. Uses 'subtle' level (lower contrast than icon per WCAG — decorative border). Lite: --message-info-border-color → color/system/info/subtle.

variables.name: component/message/border/success-default
variables.comment: Success variant 4px left stripe. Lite: --message-success-border-color → color/system/success/subtle.

variables.name: component/message/border/warning-default
variables.comment: Warning variant 4px left stripe. Lite: --message-warning-border-color → color/system/warning/subtle.

variables.name: component/message/border/error-default
variables.comment: Error variant 4px left stripe. Lite: --message-error-border-color → color/system/danger/subtle.

variables.name: component/message/icon/information-default
variables.comment: Information variant icon. Uses 'default' level (higher contrast than border — meaningful icon per WCAG). Lite: --message-info-icon-color → color/system/info/default.

variables.name: component/message/icon/success-default
variables.comment: Success variant icon. Lite: --message-success-icon-color → color/system/success/default.

variables.name: component/message/icon/warning-default
variables.comment: Warning variant icon. Lite: --message-warning-icon-color → color/system/warning/default.

variables.name: component/message/icon/error-default
variables.comment: Error variant icon. Lite: --message-error-icon-color → color/system/danger/default.

variables.name: component/message/border/radius-default
variables.comment: Corner radius. Aliased to brand primitives for consistency with -input.

variables.name: component/message/border/width-default
variables.comment: Left border stripe width. Aliased to brand primitives for consistency with -input.
